title: Analytics history
responsibility: Displays recorded loop history and frequency summaries.

inputs.name: AnalyticsHistory.summary
inputs.description: Required aggregate counts for templates, commands, evaluator outcomes and daily activity. Frequency bars scale to the largest count; percentages show each count’s share of its category total. Daily rows appear newest first.

inputs.name: AnalyticsHistory.loops
inputs.description: Required loop history rows supplying names, templates, models, status, timestamps, duration and evaluation count. Empty shows no loops recorded; absent optional timestamps or durations display a dash.

outputs.name: AnalyticsHistory
outputs.description: Loop table with UTC labels and missing values shown as a dash, plus frequency bars for four summary groups. Bars scale to the largest count while percentages represent share of the group total. Daily keys sort newest first; other groups sort by descending count. Empty histories and groups have explicit messages.
